properties.Name: Bombay
properties.Description: The cotton-mill capital of western India, in Maharashtra. This is the MAIN place.

properties.Name: Girangaon
properties.Description: The mill district at the heart of Bombay, where much of the textile workforce lived and worked.

properties.Name: Bombay Harbour
properties.Description: The deep-water port that made Bombay a hub for cotton exports and imports.

properties.Name: Elephanta Caves
properties.Description: Rock-cut temples on an island in Bombay Harbour, part of the region's older layered history.

properties.Name: Pune
properties.Description: A major inland Maharashtra city connected to Bombay by trade and, later, rail.

properties.Name: Nashik
properties.Description: A Maharashtra city on the Godavari, linked to Bombay through regional trade and pilgrimage routes.

properties.Name: Nagpur
properties.Description: A central-Maharashtra city and a cotton-growing and trading center feeding the mills.

properties.Name: Kolhapur
properties.Description: A city in southern Maharashtra tied into regional textile and trade networks.

properties.Name: Ratnagiri
properties.Description: A Konkan-coast district that sent many migrant workers to Bombay's mills.

properties.Name: Ahmednagar
properties.Description: An inland Maharashtra town connected to Bombay through regional commerce.

properties.Name: Solapur
properties.Description: A Maharashtra textile town and a center of cotton weaving connected to Bombay.

properties.Name: Manchester
properties.Description: The center of Britain's cotton industry; source of mill machinery and a competitor to Bombay's mills.

properties.Name: Liverpool
properties.Description: The British port through which cotton and goods moved between Britain and Bombay.

properties.Name: London
properties.Description: The imperial capital and financial center that shaped Bombay's trade and industry.

properties.Name: Shanghai
properties.Description: A major overseas market for Bombay mill yarn across the Indian Ocean and to East Asia.

properties.Name: Hong Kong
properties.Description: A British trading hub on the route east, linked to Bombay's export trade.

properties.Name: Singapore
properties.Description: A key entrepot on the shipping route between Bombay and East Asia.

properties.Name: Zanzibar
properties.Description: An Indian Ocean market for Indian cotton cloth through long-standing trade networks.

properties.Name: Aden
properties.Description: A coaling and trade waypoint on the sea route between Bombay and Europe.

properties.Name: Suez
properties.Description: The canal, opened in 1869, that shortened the sea route between Bombay and Britain.

properties.Name: Yokohama
properties.Description: A Japanese port connected to Bombay through East Asian trade.
